witnesses: KeepHasFinitePlAndGenuineProofWithFormalClosed: complete existing P103 single-mode fixture, original allocations and numerics; finite PL proof only.

UwbExclusionRemovesExactlyItsCoveredScope: existing current/history fixture; sole represented faulty mode projected only by production covered-mode projector; removed source risk still requires final selection ledger.

ImuBridgeIsIndependentAndItsBoxMarginFinite: real research config, unchanged generated hypothesis census, original bridge specification; production bridge factor H/z at a common previous/CV reference and covariance are independent of injected IMU accel, deterministic margin finite; pending raw H/z at distinct IMU-influenced linearization points need not match; NOT_FULL_PL.

required_conditions: Topology and mutation order depend only on group/priority; never read stale aggregate for mutation or decisions.
Every changed child/leaf and all current ancestors are dirty; rotation marks both old and new parents. Clean-parent implies all descendants clean.
Final refresh recursively left, right, node before summary or certification; keep exact merge(left,leaf) then merge(result,right) with original requested UID order.
Reference retains original per-leaf refresh; compare final matrix bits, sigma/V, rank, proof identities, detector/PL/selection/publication; only work counts may differ.
Full raw oracle fallback, invalid-tree reset, all rank/threshold/risk/publication gates stay unchanged.
treap_review.exception_review: The preexisting implementation lacked a mutation reset guard. Commit 56a5d8c wraps mutations plus dirty refresh in catch: invalidate and rethrow. This protects reuse after failure without swallowing exceptions. The normal-path exact-bit oracle PASS does not itself exercise allocation failures.

limitations: The four production records are existing measured evidence, not a new timing experiment.
Terminal UNBOUNDED with null candidate values is not alone proof of mathematical unboundedness.
Finite numerical-layer PL and bridge witnesses do not close the complete production risk ledger or establish external formal qualification.
Candidate HPL/VPL values are taken at the original candidates.csv logging precision; this review does not reconstruct full precision numerical matrices.
